corpus.title: Polygondwanaland
corpus.motto: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard's 2017 polymetric concept album, annotated for structural analysis
corpus.text: [Polygondwanaland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygondwanaland) is the twelfth studio album by Australian psychedelic rock band [King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Gizzard_%26_the_Lizard_Wizard), released in 2017. The album makes extensive use of polymetric structures, with several metric patterns coexisting and interacting throughout, making it a rich corpus for the study of musical structure, rhythm, and meter [Daniel et al., SMC 2026](https://hal.science/hal-05710365)
corpus.availability: This annotated database was built as part of the PhD work of Mathys Daniel (IRMA, University of Strasbourg / LIP6, Sorbonne University). All 10 tracks of the album are provided with audio, MIDI (derived from an 8-bit cover by 8-bit Escapades), symbolic scores, and structural annotations combining algorithmic and manual analysis. As of September 2026, the manual annotation is still ongoing.
